summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the omnichannel order-orchestration node. The strongest direct mapping is Manhattan Associates as the reference leader in supply-chain execution and omnichannel commerce software. The underfollowed lane is more interesting: SPS Commerce provides embedded retail trading-partner connectivity, Descartes adds logistics/TMS/ecommerce fulfillment network exposure, and Lightspeed offers SMB/mid-market omnichannel POS, inventory, supplier and order workflow exposure. These are research candidates only, not recommendations. Expanded the universe for the operational-complexity chokepoint in consumer retail fulfillment. The reference anchor is Manhattan Associates because its public filings directly map to warehouse management, order management, store fulfillment, inventory availability, and transportation workflows. The underfollowed lane is more interesting: SPS Commerce sits in retail trading-partner connectivity and EDI/order document flow; Descartes provides logistics network, routing, transportation, ecommerce inventory and warehouse-adjacent software; Hackett is a smaller implementation/transformation-services shadow candidate where the thesis is less proven but potentially tied to the scarce implementation-capacity bottleneck. No trading recommendation is made. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around retail fulfillment complexity.
